question: What kind of prior accomplishment must be given only after it has been tested for one year?
premises: A prior accomplishment is a candidate for giving.
Such a candidate must undergo testing.
The required test duration is one year.
inference: Only a prior accomplishment tested for one year is fit to be given.
uncertainties: The identity of the recipient is not specified.
plain_english: What was accomplished before is to be given only after it has been tested for one year.
